method: Own ideas plus Shopify generate-business-names; .com availability from Shopify generate-domain-names (point-in-time, not a hold); conflict check = one web search per finalist (not a trademark search). The founder buys the domain and runs USPTO/EUIPO searches.

candidates.name: Countersign Security
candidates.conflict_search: No security company found; nearest is 'Countersight' (Canberra, AU, security research) — different spelling and market; 'countersign' is a common English word, so TM strength is moderate.
candidates.rationale: To countersign is to add an independent second signature confirming a document. That is exactly the offer: an outside tester confirms what the office's written plan says. Plain word an office owner already knows.

candidates.name: Clearfile Security
candidates.conflict_search: No security/compliance company found by that name.
candidates.rationale: 'A clear file' for the Safeguards record; tax-office language.

candidates.name: Tested Office
candidates.rationale: Says what the buyer gets; descriptive, so weak as a trademark.

candidates.name: Safeguards Desk
candidates.rationale: Clear, but leans on the regulation's name, which can read as official/FTC-affiliated; descriptive, weak as a trademark.

candidates.name: TrustWave
candidates.status: rejected: Trustwave is an established security company

candidates.name: SafeHarbor Checks
candidates.status: rejected: 'safe harbor' is a legal term; implies legal protection

candidates.name: SecureLedger
candidates.status: rejected: generic, likely in use in fintech

candidates.name: SafeGuard TaxCheck
candidates.status: rejected: too close to competitor SafeGuardGRC; tax-only
